title: Private deployment: customer network sandbox + automated remediation recipes for intake triage
creator: Liam Patel
description:
Problem: We see repeated private/VPC/on-prem intake tickets that fail initial networking checks or require manual engineering intervention for common issues (proxy auth, MTU misconfiguration, internal DNS, intermittent packet loss during large model downloads). This creates long lead times and high SE/solutions effort for customers.

Objective: Provide a lightweight, reproducible "network sandbox" that customers or SEs can run to self-validate and capture diagnostics, plus a set of deterministic remediation recipes that map common failure signatures to recommended fixes or automated scripts. The goal is to reduce mean time-to-onboard for Private/VPC customers by 40% and cut SE-assisted triage hours by 60% for the top 10 failure modes.

Scope:
- In scope: network sandbox CLI/container image, standardized diagnostics collection (pcap, traceroutes, DNS traces, TLS handshake metadata), failure signature catalog, remediation recipe library (shell scripts, Ansible snippets, Kubernetes manifest examples), Console intake integration to attach sandbox results to requests.
- Out of scope for this ticket: full airgap-only deployment orchestration and hardware procurement workflows.

Success metrics:
- 40% reduction in avg days-to-ready for private onboardings where networking was the blocker.
- At least 60% of incoming network-failure tickets match a signature in the catalog within 30 days of rollout.
- SE time per triage reduced from median 4h -> 1.5h for matched signatures.

Non-functional requirements:
- Sandbox must be runnable in customer environments without root where possible (userland tooling path).
- Data collected must be documented for PII/secret avoidance; all artifacts stored encrypted in our intake attachments only with explicit consent.

Acceptance criteria:
- Public PRD and a PoC container image available in the private deployments repo.
- 10 remediation recipes covering top failures (proxy, MTU, DNS, TLS, intermittent packet loss, download throttling, IP whitelisting, NTP drift, fragmented packets, asymmetric routing).
- Console integration: a dropdown to attach sandbox run and auto-parse failure signature into the Linear request.
